popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Eurytus (Erytus) of Alope, son of Hermes and brother of Echion, joins the Argo — crafty twin of the thief-god's house. Not Eurytus of Oechalia whom Heracles shot for the bow-prize.

popCulture.title: Eurytus
popCulture.description: Argonaut son of Hermes — one of several mythic Eurytuses; here the brother of Echion of Alope.
